dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric 2D narrowing from the mid-body lateral maxima toward the posterior peduncle terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth lateral margins with a minor convex expansion on the left mid-section relative to the longitudinal axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline with low-frequency blue-tone saturation in shadowed lateral regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark circular aperture corresponding to the blowhole at the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear topological elevation (dorsal ridge) extending along the posterior half of the central axis, creating a distinct light-to-shadow gradient.
